subject: Re: Community Lab Hack Week — promo allowance & mentor credits

Subject: Community Lab Hack Week — request for platform promo and mentor credits

Hi Rishi / Marissa,

Thanks again for taking the time at OSS Summit — excited to follow up. OpenBuilders is running Community Lab Hack Week (Oct 18-22) — ~250 participants, 40 teams, a focus on civic-tech and accessibility tools. We'd love Redwood to participate as a platform partner.

What we're asking for:
- Platform promo credits for up to 50 teams (so teams can experiment without billing friction)
- Two dedicated mentor-hours each day (virtual/onsite) from Redwood engineers for live debugging and prompt tuning
- A small booth presence + up to 100 event t-shirts (logo placement)

Attached is a short proposal + budget outline. We're flexible on format (voucher codes, trial extensions, temporary org seats). Our deadline for partner confirmations is Aug 7 so we can put partners on the site and print materials.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful.

Cheers,
Alex Rivera
Community Programs Lead
OpenBuilders Collective
Attachments: CommunityLab_HackWeek_Proposal_v3.pdf, hackweek-budget.xlsx

Hi Alex — thanks for the proposal and the heads-up on the Aug 7 deadline. Appreciate the clear ask. A few clarifying Qs before we scope internal approvals: 

1) Promo model: are you looking for per-team voucher codes (unique codes) or an org-level trial (one seat with N credits)?
2) Mentor hours: are the hours mostly office-hours style on Zoom or do you expect onsite dedicated shifts? Travel budget / expenses?
3) T-shirts: confirmed 100 units? Any special sizing distribution?

Tentatively I can offer: a 90-day trial extension for 50 teams (up to 100k tokens total across teams), 8 mentor-hours (2/day virtual) and a promotional booth presence. I need Marissa and Karthik to confirm the promotional credit allocation and any swag spend approvals.

I've attached the proposal to our internal thread and will loop in Karthik for finance sign-off. Can you send a one-page invoice/PO request for the booth and shirts?

Best,
Rishi
Head of Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference

- Promo: 50 team vouchers, each voucher = $150 credit (equivalent) — total exposure ~$7,500

- Mentor hours: we'll staff 2 x 2-hr Zoom sessions per day for the week (8 total) from the Developer Relations rotation (no travel)
- Swag: approve $1,000 budget for 80 shirts (we'll cover print & shipping)

Please confirm if the 3 sandbox orgs approach works for you, Alex — that avoids code proliferation and simplifies support. Karthik — tagging you for finance/contract check and DocuSign MOU.
